title: Xdrip+ cant sync when is connected to 3G/4G
body:
Hi
Xdrip+ master (from kid) do not send data to followers (parents) when is master connected to 3G/4G/Data.
When is master connected to WiFi all work great.
All work perfectly in begging and on 3G/4G/Data but it seems that problem appears after xdrip or MIUI update, I cant be sure.

Xdrip+ have ALL permissions to connect through data and wifi and permission to work in background.
I tried reinstalling xdrip with clearing all data and tried and nightly builds also.
Nothing helped :-(
Please can you have some hint/solution ?

Mobile phone is Xiaomi Mi8

TNX for help

comments.body: Hi, in addition to mobile Internet, both smartphones must have GPS turned on
